The '''Sentient Greatlance''' is a type of [[Weapons|Weapon]].

It is the direct upgrade to the [[Living Lance]].
==''Obtainment''==
Sentient Weapons evolve from their craftable Living counterpart after having dealt 50,000 damage.
==''Usage''==
'''Fighting'''

The Sentient Greatlance is a Melee Weapon. Its attack reach is 7 blocks in each direction from the players head, which is the default attack reach.

Each time it is swung, it performs the default sweeping attack (though only visually if airborne or the attack cooldown is still up), and applies the <u>[[Needler|Needler II]]</u><ref>needs verification</ref> effect to the directly targeted mob.
